title: Lost card, merchant wants to retry

referral.merchant_message: Declined, can we just keep retrying the card?

steps.text: I'll investigate this referral by looking up the merchant, transaction, and card status.
Now let me check the card status to confirm:

The investigation is clear. The transaction was declined because the card (ending 6631) has been reported as lost or stolen. This is confirmed by both the decline reason and the card status check. The merchant is asking to retry the card, but this is not appropriate since the card is flagged as lost or stolen.

The merchant is legitimate: Northgate Cycles is a well-established UK sporting goods merchant (on-boarded 2019, verified KYB, consistent trading pattern). Sanctions screening shows no matches. No earlier referrals.

I'll resolve this with appropriate guidance:

input.message_to_merchant: The card used for this transaction has been reported as lost or stolen. We cannot process retries on this card. Please ask the customer to use a different payment method or contact their card issuer.
input.reason: Card reported lost or stolen - legitimate decline, no retry appropriate

proposal.message_to_merchant: The card used for this transaction has been reported as lost or stolen. We cannot process retries on this card. Please ask the customer to use a different payment method or contact their card issuer.
proposal.reason: Card reported lost or stolen - legitimate decline, no retry appropriate

outcome.message_to_merchant: Please do not retry this card. Follow the retained-card procedure in your merchant guide; our team will contact you.
guardrails: Hard rule HR2 applied: the agent proposed 'resolve'.
